aliases: Why provide links in learning sessions?

one_line_answer.text: Links help learners tie new information into existing knowledge.

cites.quote: Providing links between learning sessions meets two of the key learning principles identified earlier: that learners remember best the first and last points of a learning session, and that learners need to tie new information into existing knowledge.

keywords.bn: আগের ও পরের শেখার সাথে সংযোগ

bangla_explanation: নতুন কিছু শিখলে আমরা সেটাকে জানা জিনিসের সাথে link করি।
Learners session-এর first আর last points সবচেয়ে ভালো মনে রাখে।
তাই introduction-এ আগের session-এর key points বলুন, review-তে পরের session-এর কথা বলুন।
একদম নতুন বিষয় হলে life experience বা comparison দিয়ে বোঝান।

short.prompt: Why do you need to provide links in learning sessions?
short.modelAnswer:
Links meet two key learning principles:
1. Learners remember best the first and last points of a session.
2. Learners need to tie new information into existing knowledge.
In the introduction, summarise the previous session. In the review, relate this session to the next.

keyPoints.text: In your introduction, summarise the key points from the previous session.

cites.quote: you should, in your introduction, summarise the key points from the previous session

keyPoints.text: In your review, refer to how this session will relate to the next.

cites.quote: In your review, you should refer to how this session will relate to the next.

keyPoints.text: For new material, relate it to life experience or an appropriate comparison.

cites.quote: If you are introducing completely new material, you should try to relate the information to something that the learners will already know, either through life experience or by use of an appropriate comparison.
